POWER MECHANICS — MOCK EXAM #11
====

GRADE: Grade 12
SUBJECT: POWER MECHANICS
TIME ALLOWED: 2 hours
TOTAL MARKS: 80
EXAM BODY: KNEC / KCSE pathway

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. When learning Assembly drawing and Sectioning, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Skip safety briefings for Assembly drawing and Sectioning.
   B. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Assembly drawing and Sectioning.
   C. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Assembly drawing and Sectioning.
   D. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Assembly drawing and Sectioning.
